visual_action: The video is a slideshow of two static images. The first image is a screenshot of a tweet from the 'Democrats' account. The tweet says, 'We got the Trump gamer tax before GTA 6' and quotes a tweet from 'FactPost' about Sony raising PS5 prices due to 'Trump's tariffs.' Below the tweets is a split image showing Donald Trump with a pained expression holding a document, next to the PlayStation 5 (PS5) logo. The second image is a screenshot of an article from 'The Verge' stating that Sony is raising PS5 prices and that the reason cited includes 'the tariffs President Trump has placed on imported products,' with this phrase highlighted in yellow.

on_screen_text.text: We got the Trump gamer tax before GTA 6

FactPost @factpostnews · 1h
Sony is raising PS5 prices by $50 in the US tomorrow, citing the “challenging economic environment,” including Trump’s tariffs.

Sony is raising the price of all PlayStation 5 models by $50 in the US. In a blog post announcing the change, Sony cited the “challenging economic environment,” which includes the tariffs President Trump has placed on imported products.
